name: SearchApi.io
description: Real-time structured search and ad-library data from Google, Bing, app stores, marketplaces, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and other public web sources. Public API-key signup includes 100 free requests with no credit card.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: API Key
credential_fields.description: SearchApi.io API key. Create an account at searchapi.io; the key is injected as a Bearer token automatically.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Run a real-time search against a query-based SearchApi engine. For app stores and ad libraries, prefer the dedicated tools because their parameters differ.

engine.description: Engine such as google, google_light, google_ai_mode, google_news, google_images, google_maps, google_shopping, google_scholar, google_jobs, bing, bing_news, yahoo, baidu, yandex, duckduckgo, naver, youtube, amazon, ebay, walmart, or bestbuy.

tools.name: apple_app_store_search
tools.description: Search iPhone/iPad or Mac apps in an Apple App Store country storefront.

tools.name: apple_app_store_top_charts
tools.description: Retrieve real-time Apple App Store top-free or top-paid charts by country, device, and category, including game subcategories.

category.description: all, an *_apps category, or game category such as action_games, puzzle_games, strategy_games, or simulation_games.

tools.name: meta_ad_library_search
tools.description: Search Meta's public Ad Library by keyword, Facebook Page ID, or location. This uses SearchApi credentials and does not require a separately approved Meta developer app. For large pagination tokens use meta_ad_library_search_post.

q.description: Keyword query; wrap phrases in double quotes for exact matching.

platforms.description: Comma-separated facebook, instagram, audience_network, messenger, or threads.

tools.name: meta_ad_library_search_post
tools.description: Search or paginate Meta Ad Library results with parameters in a JSON body. Prefer this when next_page_token becomes too large for a GET URL.

tools.name: meta_ad_library_page_search
tools.description: Find Facebook/Instagram Page IDs and Meta location IDs before searching their ads.

tools.name: meta_ad_library_page_info
tools.description: Retrieve Meta Ad Library Page metadata, transparency history, ownership, admin locations, Instagram details, and available spend information.

tools.name: meta_ad_library_ad_details
tools.description: Retrieve detailed transparency and targeting data for one Meta ad using ad_details_token from Meta Ad Library search results.

tools.name: linkedin_ad_library_search
tools.description: Search LinkedIn's public Ad Library by keyword, advertiser, country, and date range.

country.description: One country or comma-separated ISO country codes.

time_period.description: last_year, this_year, this_month, last_30_days, or YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: tiktok_advertiser_search
tools.description: Find TikTok Ad Library advertisers by name and return advertiser IDs and recommended advertiser tokens.

tools.name: tiktok_ad_library_search
tools.description: Search TikTok's public Ads Library by keyword or advertiser. Prefer advertiser_token from tiktok_advertiser_search; advertiser_id alone is no longer sufficient.

q.description: Keyword, or advertiser name when advertiser_id is supplied.

advertiser_id.description: Must be combined with the advertiser name in q; advertiser_token is preferred.

time_period.description: YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to the last year.

tools.name: tiktok_ad_details
tools.description: Retrieve one TikTok ad's creative assets, advertiser, targeting, audience size, and impression data.

tools.name: account
tools.description: Get current usage, remaining credits, hourly limit, and subscription period. This endpoint does not consume a search credit.

tools.name: get_search
tools.description: Retrieve a previously completed SearchApi result by the search ID returned in search_metadata.id.

tools.name: search_analytics
tools.description: Retrieve account search analytics for the last year. SearchApi currently requires a Scale plan or higher for this endpoint.

time_period_max.description: End date or RFC 3339 timestamp; use the same timezone as time_period_min.
